title: Woodview, Dangan, Celbridge, Co. Kildare, W23Y16A
seoTitle: Woodview, Dangan, Celbridge, Co. Kildare, W23Y16A
description:
• Coonan Property present a unique opportunity to own a spacious residence on approx. 19.5 acres of land, located just 3km from Celbridge town centre 
• Woodview offers a rare opportunity to own a substantial land holding so close to transport links, Celbridge and all local amenities
• The residence extends to approx. 195 sq.m and comprises entrance hallway, living room, study/playroom, open plan kitchen/dining area, utility room, four double bedrooms and two bathrooms
• The land is accessible through the house and by a second entrance which leads directly into a hard surface yard with two large sheds, suitable for farming, machinery or conversion to equestrian use
• Just a short 5 minutes from highly regarded local schools in both Ardclough and Celbridge and just 2.5kmm from Hazelhatch Train Station for easy commuting
• Located just minutes from the M7 and M4 motorways with easy access into Celbridge, Straffan, Maynooth, Naas and Dublin
• A fine family home offering rural privacy and tranquillity and within easy reach of all local amenities
